title: A boundary an EVA-03 job cannot leave: a dedicated job user
goal: Every process an EVA-03 job starts runs as a dedicated macOS user, and everything that user runs ends with the job
acceptance: Test committed failing first: a quick exit after detaching a child, and a double fork after setsid, leave nothing running after the job
The job runs as its own user; at the end every process of that user is killed and the table is checked; a fork bomb fills only that user's process limit
The owner's one-time setup (the service user and the runner's permission to switch to it) is a copy-paste procedure with its expected result
privacy: Neutral repository-owned fixtures only; no credentials, model calls or external effects in tests.
escalation: The service user and its permission need the owner's setup on each Mac; a material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-19 from the review of PR #549; owner setup apart. Not a measurement.
